name: Sielanic Rituals — 1 Basic — One With the Land

system.description:
This ritual attunes the Sielanic caster to a specific plot of ground, no larger than 10 square miles, letting her thereafter work the powers of the Sielanic Path of the World's Blood within it. Whenever she relocates, she may attune herself anew to the fresh location in the same fashion, but she can only be attuned to one place at a time; a lapsed attunement can be renewed by repeating the ritual.

System: The vampire combines her blood with earth, tree sap, or another natural substance from the site and covers herself in the mixture before resting for the day, absorbing the land's essence. Successes determine the duration, intensity, or range of the resulting attunement.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
system.bloodCost: 2 Blood Traits, mixed with earth or another natural substance from the site
system.duration: Until renewed or superseded by a new attunement
system.prerequisites: Sielanic Path of the World's Blood
